proposition: MK counts four texts as ‘the apologies’: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I and II and the creedal tracts R. Iʿtiqādāt and R. Iʿtiqādiyya. On the pages read here, the R. Iʿtiqādāt is named once and nothing is said about its content.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
